description: This file contains functions and classes for performing MILP-based optimization of checkpointing and memory management in distributed training, specifically for the SAC (Selective Activation Checkpointing) algorithm. It includes methods for solving ILP problems to determine optimal module activation and operator checkpointing under memory constraints.

classes.name: SACDecision
classes.description: Enumeration for SAC checkpointing decisions: RECOMPUTE (0) and SAVE (1).

methods.name: sac_milp
methods.description: Performs MILP optimization to decide which modules to activate and how much memory to discard, minimizing recomputation time under a memory budget.

methods.name: get_optimal_checkpointing_policy_per_module
methods.description: Determines the optimal set of operators to checkpoint within a memory budget using MILP, based on SACStats.
